_note: Limits verified against each provider's own docs on 2026-11-08 (NVIDIA: no official table, community-verified). gemini, zai, kilo, cohere and vercel added and cerebras rechecked 2026-11-22 from their docs. Model ids verified the same day except NVIDIA's (catalog unreachable); `pocket doctor` warns after 30 days. pocket trusts live 429s over these numbers. A copy in your config dir overrides this file. price_per_mtok values are placeholders used only to enforce daily_cap_usd; set your real prices.

groq.label: Groq
groq.source: https://console.groq.com/docs/rate-limits (table is labelled Developer-plan base limits; your console may show lower)

cerebras.label: Cerebras
cerebras.setup_note: $5 trial credit for 30 days; needs a card
cerebras.source: https://inference-docs.cerebras.ai/support/rate-limits (checked 2026-11-22): no permanent free tier; the Free Trial is $5 in credits that expire 30 days after they are granted, after adding a verified payment method. Trial limits for gpt-oss-120b: 5 rpm, 1M tokens/day.
cerebras.notice: Cerebras no longer has a free tier: new accounts get a $5 trial that expires after 30 days and needs a verified payment method. Not in the default order; add it while your trial lasts.

nvidia.label: NVIDIA
nvidia.setup_note: about 40 requests a minute; phone verification
nvidia.source: model ids from https://integrate.api.nvidia.com/v1/models on 2026-11-14 (meta/llama-3.3-70b-instruct was retired, 410); ~40 rpm is community-verified, NVIDIA publishes no table

openrouter.label: OpenRouter
openrouter.setup_note: 50 requests a day on free models
openrouter.source: openrouter/free routes to a currently free model with the needed features, so retired :free ids don't break pocket. 50 rpd; 1,000 rpd after $10 lifetime credit purchase: raise rpd in your override. https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/reference/limits

mistral.label: Mistral
mistral.notice: Requests on Mistral's free Experiment plan may be used to train Mistral's models. Not in the default order; add it to pocket.yml yourself if that is acceptable.

gemini.label: Google Gemini
gemini.setup_note: free quota per model; see AI Studio
gemini.source: OpenAI-compatible endpoint: https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/openai. Free-tier limits are per model and shown only in Google AI Studio (https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/rate-limits); models with no free quota answer 429 'limit: 0' and pocket drops them for 24h.
gemini.notice: On the free tier Google may use your prompts and code to improve its products, and human reviewers may read them (outside the EEA, Switzerland and the UK). https://ai.google.dev/gemini-api/terms. Not in the default order; add it if that is acceptable.

zai.label: Z.ai (GLM)
zai.source: GLM-4.7-Flash and GLM-4.5-Flash are free per https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/pricing.md; base URL from https://docs.z.ai/guides/overview/quick-start.md. Rate limits are not published outside the Z.ai console.
zai.notice: pocket has not verified how Z.ai (Zhipu) handles data sent to its free models. Not in the default order; add it if that is acceptable.

kilo.label: Kilo Gateway
kilo.setup_note: free models and an auto-free route; limits not published
kilo.source: Base URL and tool/stream support: https://kilo.ai/docs/gateway/api-reference. Free models and kilo-auto/free: https://kilo.ai/docs/code-with-ai/agents/free-and-budget-models. Free roster changes; pocket only uses ids ending in :free and kilo-auto/free.
kilo.notice: Kilo's free route can send requests to providers that log prompts and outputs and use them to improve their services (Kilo's docs say not to send confidential data). Not in the default order; add it if that is acceptable.

cohere.label: Cohere
cohere.setup_note: trial key: 20 requests a minute, 1,000 a month
cohere.source: Trial limits: https://docs.cohere.com/docs/rate-limits (20 req/min on chat, 1,000 calls/month). OpenAI-compatible endpoint: https://docs.cohere.com/docs/compatibility-api
cohere.notice: Cohere's free keys are trial keys meant for evaluation: 1,000 calls a month in total. Not in the default order; add it if that is acceptable.

vercel.label: Vercel AI Gateway
vercel.setup_note: free credit every month on a Hobby account; a subset of models
vercel.source: Base URL and /models: https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/sdks-and-apis/openai-chat-completions. Free tier: monthly free credit on a subset of models, spent at list price, rate limited per model; buying credits ends the free credit (https://vercel.com/docs/ai-gateway/pricing). free_models keeps pocket on low-cost open models so the credit lasts.
vercel.notice: Vercel's free tier is a small monthly credit spent at each model's list price, and only some models are in it; when it runs out Vercel answers 402 and pocket moves on. Not in the default order; add it if you want it as a last resort.

anthropic.label: Anthropic
anthropic.setup_note: paid; used first, up to the daily cap
anthropic.source: paid; capped by daily_cap_usd in pocket.yml

openai.label: OpenAI
openai.source: paid; capped by daily_cap_usd in pocket.yml
